blockers.summary: The repository source-of-truth ordering introduced during October reconciliation does not match the active hardening mandate. Re-audit the current v0.1 contract, implementation, tests, and examples against docs/LSTP_Whitepaper.pdf before release or pre-training freeze.

Canonical typed model, strict Lattice tokenizer/parser and deterministic compiler mappings are implemented for the normative grammar surface. Runtime-only context commands parse but intentionally fail canonical compilation; remaining work is validation/hardening rather than parser scaffolding.

Core semantic validation now includes identifiers, references, vocabulary, permission/profile contradictions, resource scope, evidence support, RFC3339 context/expiry fields and structural BCP47 language tags. Remaining semantic-format work is limited to any future registry-backed profiles or additional domain-specific formats.

Reference host authorization implements exact capability/resource intersection, authenticated delegation attenuation, trusted authorization references, confirmation/review/logging gates, expiry, pluggable replay-store semantics, in-process replay protection and a durable SQLite replay adapter. Distributed/shared-service replay backends and application-specific limit enforcement remain host integration work.

Positive/negative protocol vectors, canonical byte round trips, extended Lattice tests, semantic format tests, replay-store tests and host-authorization security tests exist; broader normative-vector coverage, fuzz/property coverage and cross-implementation fixtures remain incomplete.

Hostile-input, permission-escalation, delegation-widening, replay/action-mutation, evidence-provenance, Unicode/canonicalization, invalid-format and unresolved-context tests exist in part; systematic adversarial coverage remains incomplete.
No independent second implementation has passed the shared conformance vectors or reproduced canonical bytes.
Whitepaper publication revision, source figures and reproducible publication build are incomplete.
SLAI adapter/launcher and pinned package/submodule integration are not implemented.
Final clean release audit, migration policy, compatibility evidence and pre-training freeze are incomplete.
